newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Euroyen edge higher on JGBs, gains seen slow.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Euroyen edge higher on JGBs, gains seen slow.

text.p: SIMEX Euroyen futures eked out slight gains on the back of a surge in Japanese government bond (JGB) futures on Friday but dealers said the market would have trouble sustaining its highs.

Japanese bonds were underpinned by the recent rally in U.S. treasury markets after Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan's congressional testimony this week removed fears of a near-term credit tightening.
